items.html: Hence we will now explain what was renewed then, on that eve of Sabbath after midday: when he was created, only his head and throat were in the Garden of Eden, as mentioned, while the rest of his body was in this world; but now he entered wholly into the Garden of Eden, and the worlds rose in this manner: Zeir Anpin rose to the place that is now the place of Arich Anpin, and the Nukva of Zeir Anpin rose to the place that is now the place of Aba, and Beriah rose to the place that is now the place of Ima, and Yetzira to the place of Zeir Anpin, and Assiya to the place of Malchut, the Nukva of Zeir Anpin; the first four of Assiya rose, for such is the measure of the Nukva of Zeir Anpin, four Sefirot only, and the remaining six Sefirot of Assiya rose to the place of the first six of Beriah as it now is. Indeed, Aba ve Ima of Atzilut too, and all that is above them, likewise rose above their degree, in this same order, and there is no need to elaborate on them.
